_about: The players who are whole characters of their own (tools/make_player.sh makes the raw models with Tripo, tools/prep_player.py turns them into assets/player/people/<id>.glb). `template` is the prompt for the concept picture, with `{who}` and `{refs}` from the player; `images` are the pictures given with it (image[1], image[2], from the project root). The kit is always three flat greys (jersey near-white, pants mid grey, socks dark grey): those are what the game repaints per team. `source` is the rigged model, from the project root; a player without one is skipped by prep_player.py. A player made after a face that already exists gets that face as image[1] and a concept as image[2]; the others get one concept as image[1] (Moe's for heavy people, Dash's for light ones: the body in the picture pulls a new one toward it). Moe Peel's concept was made first (template, then one image-to-image edit that gave him grey pants and dark socks) and is image[2] of the others, so that everybody wears the same kit in the same style: give a new player Moe's concept as image[2] too. `character` is who the player is, for anything made about him or her later (voice lines, commentary, a card): `summary` in one line, then `gender`, `age`, `heritage`, `build`, `look`, `personality` and `plays_like` (what the ratings say). It describes the model as it came out, which is not always what `who` asked for: keep it up to date when a player is redone.
template: A new character: an amateur football player, {who}. {refs} Full body, front view, standing upright in a T-pose with arms straight out to the sides, palms down, fingers slightly apart, legs slightly apart. Stylized 3D cartoon character, an everyday person rather than an athlete, with a slightly big head, slightly oversized hands and shoes, smooth matte clay look, a detailed and expressive face, sculpted chunky hair, soft folds in the clothes, and well-defined hands, elbows and knees. The kit: a loose short-sleeved football jersey in plain near-white, pants ending just below the knee in plain mid grey, long socks in plain dark grey, each one flat colour with no logos, no numbers, no text, no stripes and no trim in another colour. Bare arms and bare hands, no helmet, no pads. Mouth closed. Matte, no gloss. Flat, even lighting. Single isolated figure on a plain flat blue-grey background, no floor shadow, no props.
